name: ARA4013
title: Theme token cycle
summary: Theme tokens refer to each other in a cycle or nest beyond the resolution limit.
html:
Theme tokens refer to each other in a cycle or nest beyond the resolution limit.

#Common causes

  • Two tokens defined in terms of each other.

#Fixes

  • Define one of the tokens with a literal colour.

  • Code: ARA4013

  • Constant: ui::TOKEN_CYCLE

  • Reported by: ara-ui
